jobs.name: knockdown_a_3
jobs.prompt: Asset: one blue boxer falling-animation sprite on a TRUE TRANSPARENT SQUARE canvas. Image1 is the authoritative final Down pose and image3 is the approved upright character identity. Image2 is a pose reference with overlapping neighbors: reconstruct ONLY the intended central boxer, never copy neighbors, checkerboard or cropped limbs. Match character proportions, compact athletic tan body, short black hair, blue gloves/shorts/lace-up boots, white trim and black ink. Keep logical512x512 canvas, root(256,448), floor/baseline448, right-facing, same character scale as references: head roughly60px on512canvas, no zoom or per-pose fitting. Both COMPLETE legs and boots, exactly two arms/two legs, single solid opaque figure. No labels, ground shadow, impact lines, ghosting or backgrounds. Use generous transparent margins. POSE: fall forward from hands-and-knees onto BENT FOREARMS. Both knees still on floor, hips raised above torso, back curved, head lowered toward the guarding gloves but not yet resting. Torso/back top around logicaly300, head aroundy335, forearms/gloves onfloor448. Rear boots extend LEFT behind knees, face/right gloves point RIGHT. This is a collapse downward, not pushing up or recovery. Restore rear boots hidden by neighbors in Image2.
